title: Guarded batch delete with tenant filter, dry-run and cap
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the cap check running in dry-run mode too. That is deliberate: a dry run is how an operator learns a delete is oversized, and the contract states all guards are evaluated before any deletion in every mode, so an over-cap dry run refuses with the count in the error rather than blessing the run.
